reviews.review_description: Ray and his team were amazing to deal with.  Ray's knowledge regarding systems and the maximisation of output is incredible, and he explains how it all works in a way that someone with no knowledge can understand.  His after installation care was also great - our system had an update which knocked it offline briefly, and Ray came out before we had even noticed and checked it out to make sure it was all up and running again.  His team (Stu and Ben) are fantastic.  Their professionalism is second to none and the work they did was excellent.  Communication was great - we always knew when they were coming and they would turn up when they said they would.We are extremely happy with our system and the amount of power it is pumping out to us, and back to the grid.  Even with children that are, quite frankly, energy suckers, we are still generating more than enough through our solar panels and storing in our batteries to keep us going throughout the day and night without pulling off the grid.It is rare to find a company that does exactly what they say they will do, and not only do so but go beyond.  Having dealt with other solar companies in the past at previous residences that were a bit hit and miss, we can't recommend Central Solar Systems highly enough.

This is the 3rd system I have had installed by Ray from Central Solar systems. I find Rays knowledge as an Electrical Engineer shone through from the other 6 suppliers I contacted for quotes. One gave me a quote over the phone, one used a zoom call with only 5 coming to site. Of those 5 only 2 went on the roof for a look at the area I wanted the panels installed. Ray's attention to detail and his knowledge of local regulations had him one of only 2 of the companies picking up changes needed in my meter box to bring it up to current standards. 5 of the quotes would have resulted in changes needed once the installation started and with this extra expense. A number of the systems wouldn't have fit in the space I wanted the system installed in and this would have resulted in a smaller system or one which was installed illegally. Ray allowed space for future maintenance and cleaning and made sure the system fitted into the area based on current rules. Once installed he also monitors the system, follows up with software updates and suggests electrical suppliers once he has a better idea on how your system in performing. His installers were friendly, on time, neat and took the time to explain to me the geeky stuff an fellow electrician like me needed. Highly recommended

We cannot fault Central Solar Systems - Ray Cooper and his installers.  Ray drove from the Gold Coast to meet with me and to discuss our requirements.  He was easy to understand and was not simply a salesman.  Ray talked through various options as well as energy providers.  The installers did a fabulous job. They were professional, the panels look fantastic and they did not leave a mess. Ray came the next day to help us with monitoring system and has offered to answer any questions in the future. Great service all round.

Absolutely Brilliant!!!  I would never contemplate using the services of anyone else. After speaking to several " solar re-sellers" it was a breath of fresh air to come across Ray Cooper at Central Solar Systems. Ray's experience and knowledge was ultra impressive. He really cared about designing the most optimum system and he did just that. I am 100% happy with the outcome. You would be crazy to have solar designed and installed by anyone else.
Any info that I needed was always available by email or phone.Installation was done quicker than I expected.

The inverter was put so far up the wall that I had to get a ladder to read the digital info.!!This should be rectified this coming weekend.I am still waiting for the website information so I can download onto my laptop to keep a record of how the system is working.The handbook is very poorly written and not user friendly.There was very little handover info on completion of the job.I've been on my laptop for 3 months deciding on a system and then at the last moment I stumbled in sight of the line!!At least,all these matters should be rectified in the next week.          Feb.13 2011

I chose a local survice provider and Australian Made panels matched to a SMA Inverter which provides a 5.075kW system that has produced in excess of 31kWh on a number of days since being fully operational. Most quoters were not willing to either provide a price or supply the panels that we required, choosing instead fully imported panels and inverters that in our opinion do not offer appropriate on-shore back-up.
